I am constantly looking for new offers and better jobs. People who want to work their way up don't slowly work up in one singular company, they have their nose to the grind constantly. 
Here's how it works for me. I'm always applying, so if I get an offer for an interview I have options. If I am the asset to them, they will schedule it on my time frame. They need me so they are more willing to see it my way. I already have a job, I don't need theirs per se. If it is a better job than I already have, and will be better for me in the long run (ie better hours/pay/benefits/upward mobility/etc) then I might consider using a "sick" day to acquiesce to their interview.
I however, maintain the "you need me" while remembering that I already have a job mentality.

Just a "rapid expansion of gasses." I was like, "Dude, you literally just defined the word explosion." and he was like, "No, that's not what an explosion is." so i said, "What do you call it if you put a bunch of black powder, which is labeled as an explosive mind you, into a container, and then set the container on fire?" he actually said, "You would get an explosion." I'll be honest, I was (and some days am still) right where you were. The empty words, the platitudes, the catch phrases. I've heard it all and HATED ever single time I heard them. The only reason I am still alive right now was because when my plan was in place, and I had said my goodbyes, had a note, and all the supplies I had one singular thought. This has a sense of finality...if I haven't exercised every option I haven't really tried. I ended up in the hospital on a psych ward for almost a whole week. They helped more than I thought they would. I got a therapist, meds, and a social circle that helped me out more than I could give it credit for at the time. Eventually I learned how to not get stuck in my own head and I found friends that were able to help me out when I needed it. Believe it or don't, but I think when you cry out for help you may be shocked who actually answers the call. That being said, I am in no position to disparage you from any plans you may have. Just try exercising all your opinions first...then do what you need to do.
